overall.decision: discard current dictionary expansion as default
overall.assessment: 12/13 top5 unchanged; the only changed top5 adds a wrong-sense eating-monster result to an already weak indirect-narrator raw-recall baseline. No demonstrated quality gain. Dictionary startup and per-request recall scoring materially exceed a tiny reranking budget; these are offline timings, not native SQL. This rejects this measured first-sense expansion, not every possible dictionary method.
